title: Retain input-dependent event mass in a reusable reaction kernel
statement: A positive first-event kernel K_t has event density nu K_t 1 and posterior nu K_t/(nu K_t 1). Normalizing rows separately then using unchanged entrance weights is wrong, because the observation reweights the unknown initial state.

requires: supplied local silent generators and additive event killing
assumptions: same silent generator before and after opening
costs: source construction and local exponential evaluation paid
arbitrary exponentially large entrances are not cheap to read
contract.units: K_t has inverse-time density units; posterior is dimensionless
contract.obstruction: Avoids erasing likelihood information while transferring a posterior to a later rare event.
